rules.statement: A Viharadhipathi has legal rights enforceable in law, including the right to control and manage temple premises, appoint and dismiss officers, and claim income for maintenance of pupils and residents.
rules.supporting_quote: "He is entitled to the full possession of the Vihare and all buildings within the temple premises and their unhampered use- for the purpose of performing his religious duties and ceremonies, Gunaratne Nayake Thero v. Punchi Banda Korale (supra): For this purpose he is entitled to the income of the temple and its temporalities (section 25)."

meta.parties: Waharaka Alias Moratota Sobhita Thero v. Amunugama Ratnapala Thero
